script:
set -e
export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/build/operator/.local/bin:$PATH
cd /build/initial
export PLATFORMIO_BUILD_DIR=/build/initial/isolated-pio-build
export PLATFORMIO_LIBDEPS_DIR=/build/initial/isolated-pio-libdeps
/build/operator/.platformio/penv/bin/pio --version
/build/operator/.platformio/penv/bin/pio test --project-dir firmware/node-platform --environment native
/build/operator/.platformio/penv/bin/pio run --project-dir firmware/node-platform --environment waveshare-s3
/build/operator/.platformio/penv/bin/pio run --project-dir firmware/node-platform --environment journal-trial
log_hash_scope: log_sha256 identifies original log before documented path/ANSI normalization
